dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer shows all historic properties in Newton that are designated on local, state or national historic registries.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to real property, historic building or district analysis as well as user applications which may focus on urban planning, public works, or policy (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)
Supplemental information: Properties are added by the GIS Administrator when notified by the Preservation Planner.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational, non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
